info.name: Gingr Partner API
info.description: Owners, pets, bookings/reservations, services, invoices, payments, vaccinations, report cards, and waitlist management for Gingr's pet-care business management Partner API. Base URL: https://api.gingr.io. Every request requires X-Api-Key, subdomain, and Accept: application/vnd.api+json headers.

request.description: Lists owner (parent) records, filterable by name, email, phone, home location, or created date range.
Creates a new owner (parent) record.
Retrieves a single owner (parent) record by ID.
Updates an existing owner (parent) record.
Deletes an owner (parent) record.
Checks whether an email address already belongs to an owner record.
Checks whether a phone number already belongs to an owner record.
Merges a duplicate owner (parent) record into a surviving record.
Lists pet profiles, filterable by owner, species, or breed.
Creates a new pet profile belonging to an owner.
Retrieves a single pet profile by ID, including breed, feeding, and medication data.
Updates an existing pet profile.
Deletes a pet profile.
Merges a duplicate pet record into a surviving record.
Lists bookings/reservations, filterable by created/booking date range, status, owner, pet, or location.
Creates a new booking/reservation for a pet.
Retrieves a single booking/reservation by ID.
Updates an existing booking/reservation.
Cancels a booking, optionally recording a cancellation reason.
Checks a booking in, marking status checked_in.
Checks a booking out, typically generating an invoice.
Returns an estimated price for a booking based on its configured services and dates.

item.name: Add a service to a booking

request.description: Adds a service to an existing booking.
Returns the lodgings (kennels/runs/suites) available for a given date range.
Lists the facility's configured service types (e.g. daycare, boarding, grooming, training add-ons).
Retrieves detailed information for a specific service type.
Lists the facility's configured booking types.
Lists the facility's configured lodgings (kennels/runs/suites).
Lists the facility's locations, for multi-location Gingr accounts.
Retrieves a single location by ID.
Lists invoices, filterable by owner.
Retrieves a single invoice with line items.
Lists individual charge line items across invoices.
Refunds specific line items on an invoice.
Charges an owner's card on file for an arbitrary amount, outside of a specific invoice.
Pays an invoice using an owner's card on file.
Refunds a paid invoice.
Pays a deposit for a booking.
Lists a pet's immunization/vaccination records against the facility's configured immunization types.
Records or updates a pet's immunization/vaccination date and expiration.
Facility-wide list of expired pet immunizations, for compliance follow-up before check-in.
Lists the immunization/vaccination types the facility requires or tracks.
Lists the daily activity report cards generated for a pet, scoped to a location.
Retrieves a single report card, including notes and activities.
Lists photo/video media attached to report cards.
Returns the facility's configured report card form fields.

item.name: Move a booking to the waitlist

request.description: Moves a booking to wait_listed status, typically because the requested location or lodging is at capacity.

item.name: Accept a booking off the waitlist

request.description: Accepts a wait-listed or pending booking off the waitlist/queue and confirms it.
Lists bookings currently in wait_listed status within a date range.
